note: Layout Paragraphs Limit restricts, per Layout Paragraphs layout+region, which paragraph types may be added and how many components a region holds. All rules live in the config object layout_paragraphs_limit.settings under disallowed_types.<layout_id>.<region> => {negate: bool, numeric_limit: int, paragraph_types: {<ptype>: <ptype>|0}}. negate FALSE = exclude checked types; TRUE = include only checked types; numeric_limit 0 = unlimited. Enforcement is an event subscriber on LayoutParagraphsAllowedTypesEvent. Config route layout_paragraphs_limit.settings_form at /admin/config/content/layout_paragraphs/limit (perm: administer site configuration). Layout ids/regions are core layout plugins (layout_onecol/content, layout_twocol/top,first,second,bottom). Real paragraph types on this site include bp_card and bp_callout. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that config object.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module layout_paragraphs_limit, where are the per-region paragraph-type restrictions stored? Name the config object and the key/structure, and explain what the 'negate' flag does.
evals.expected_output: Rules live in the config object layout_paragraphs_limit.settings under disallowed_types.<layout_id>.<region>, each holding negate (bool), numeric_limit (int) and paragraph_types (checkboxes). negate=false EXCLUDES the checked paragraph types from that region; negate=true INCLUDES only the checked types.

evals.prompt: What is the admin path / route of the layout_paragraphs_limit settings form, and which permission controls access to it?
evals.expected_output: Route layout_paragraphs_limit.settings_form at /admin/config/content/layout_paragraphs/limit, gated by the core permission 'administer site configuration'.

evals.prompt: How does layout_paragraphs_limit actually enforce its restrictions at edit time in Layout Paragraphs? Which event does it react to, and how does the numeric limit work?
evals.expected_output: An event subscriber (LayoutParagraphsLimitAllowedTypesSubscriber) listens to LayoutParagraphsAllowedTypesEvent; for the edited layout+region it diffs (exclude) or intersects (include) the allowed paragraph types, and when the region already holds numeric_limit or more components it sets the allowed types to [] so nothing more can be added.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, layout_paragraphs_limit has been configured to restrict paragraph types in the 'content' region of the layout_onecol layout. Inspect the live configuration and state which paragraph type is disallowed there.
evals.expected_output: bp_card is excluded: layout_paragraphs_limit.settings -> disallowed_types.layout_onecol.content has negate=false and paragraph_types containing bp_card.

evals.prompt: On this site, layout_paragraphs_limit sets a maximum number of components on the 'first' region of the layout_twocol layout. Inspect the live configuration and state that maximum.

Using layout_paragraphs_limit on this Drupal site, configure the 'content' region of the layout_onecol layout so that the paragraph type bp_callout is NOT allowed there (exclude it). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set layout_paragraphs_limit.settings disallowed_types.layout_onecol.content to {negate: false, numeric_limit: 0, paragraph_types: {bp_callout: bp_callout}} (via the settings form or config), so bp_callout is excluded from that region.

evals.prompt: Using layout_paragraphs_limit, limit the 'second' region of the layout_twocol layout to at most 1 component. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set layout_paragraphs_limit.settings disallowed_types.layout_twocol.second.numeric_limit = 1 (with negate false and empty paragraph_types), so the region caps at one component.
